interface.inputs: Signature authority (all public constructors, parameters, types, requiredness and defaults): [IslandIcon](../../lib/src/foundation/icon.dart). Only declarations exported by lib/animal_island_ui.dart are public. This contract defines behavior; it does not maintain a second parameter list. Widget/span slots are opaque and must not be inspected or rewritten.
interface.outputs: User intent callbacks; host decides whether to commit controlled state.
interface.state_model: Controlled values are authoritative. Component owns only focus, hover, preview, motion and explicitly uncontrolled state.
interface.events: A child action dispatches once and does not activate its ancestor.
interface.composition: Parent owns placement and constraints; component owns its surface; each slot defines inherited defaults, explicit child styles win.
interface.accessibility: Named controls, states and keyboard actions. Screen-reader execution and validation are excluded by the user scope decision on 2026-10-17; named semantics and keyboard contracts remain required.
interface.localization: Reference Chinese Gallery; host content and inherited directionality.
interface.async_behavior: Host owns business requests. Timers, routes and presentation state are disposed by their creator.
interface.lifecycle: Borrowed controllers and focus nodes are never disposed by consumers.
interface.styling: One foundation-owned product palette with component-owned state recipes; documented accessibility color differences under docs/DESIGN.md. Existing contrast thresholds remain. Explicit child styles win; no opaque-child inspection, parallel palette or Gallery-only imitation. Global readable-motion authority: docs/DESIGN.md. Component-specific state and lifecycle rules remain with their owners; every transition retains the existing contrast budgets. The canonical close asset retains pinned geometry and changes only explicit X stroke to #B03038 for necessary-graphic contrast; docs/asset-provenance.json binds transformed bytes. Current scope is163 SVG glyphs. Explicit color overrides IconTheme for currentColor paint; internal multicolor asset paint stays explicit. All16 no-internal-fill glyphs use currentColor for every necessary stroke, preserving geometry; spinner pale track stays decorative. Provenance binds transformed bytes;147 filled glyphs still require contextual adjacency audit. Necessary semantic cores in pause/play/stop use #FFFDF7 against #2A9D8F; the ban slash uses #B03038 against #FAEDCD. Geometry is unchanged and transformed bytes remain bound by asset provenance. This named repair does not certify every multicolor adjacency. Necessary transparent-region strokes in docs/icon-paint-roles.json inherit the existing currentColor role; off slashes use the current asset-owned split paint described in docs/icon-paint-roles.json. Internal artwork paint is asset-owned; registered necessary-role changes retain original geometry and widths. Named raster regression covers canvas/paper light/dark and13 solid plus13 patterned Cards; no runtime background inference. Host-facing contours inherit contextual color; reviewed interior drawing ink stays fixed against its own asset fill. Explicit element roles and unchanged geometry are recorded in docs/icon-paint-roles.json. Named actual-backing contrast assertions do not certify every art adjacency. Necessary eye/beak/heat/connector/off roles are explicitly required by docs/icon-paint-roles.json; no blanket illustration exemption. Public-render147 contour/silhouette and named semantic role tests measure actual backgrounds without runtime inference. Apple stem and balloon string inherit currentColor without geometry changes. The147 host matrix has71 separately named semantic role probes at48px, plus unchanged prior own-backing regressions.
